summary: Severe tearing visible on lower-body mesh due to high r_forearm weight distribution on lower-body vertices
defects: r_forearm has 0.402 weight share in upper band and 0.087 in mid band - this weight is likely bleeding down into lower-body mesh
r_forearm weights are dragging lower-body vertices during arm rotation (rotmag 0.794 rad)
Asymmetric weight distribution: r_forearm >> l_forearm (0.402 vs 0.145)
Lower r_thigh weight (0.003) suggests weight bleed from r_forearm
proposed_fix: Redirect r_forearm weights on lower-body vertices (Y < mid_torso) to nearest leg bone (r_thigh or hips) using weight_purge.mjs with bone_target=r_thigh and y_threshold=0.3
